test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which is the world’s longest highway tunnel?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Atal Tunnel__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Atal Tunnel **has a length of 9.02 km.
 
• It is the **longest highway single-tube tunnel** at a height of 10,000 feet.
 
• Atal Tunnel is named after former Prime Minister of India, Atal Bihari Vajpayee.
 
• This tunnel was built under the Rohtang Pass in the eastern Pir Panjal range of the Himalayas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
